title: xylorhiza linearifolia
intro: Xylorhiza linearifolia, commonly known as Desert Lavender, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is prized for its small, fragrant flowers and has been used for its medicinal properties for centuries. The health benefits of Desert Lavender include its calming effects, which have been shown to reduce stress and anxiety, and its antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Desert Lavender include linalool, linalyl acetate, and β-caryophyllene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anti-inflammatory effects, and antioxidant activity.
